messages:
kai: dropped new prototype for branch-swap flow. goal: make difference between 'Branch swap' (switch traffic to different branch) and 'Rollback' explicit, and tighten timeline affordances for keyboard users. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/branch-swap (frame 4). morgan: first glance: the top-level CTA reads 'Swap' which is too terse. suggest 'Swap branch' or 'Switch to branch' for clarity. keep a compact variant 'Swap' with tooltip when space constrained. rachel: accessibility note: when performing a branch-swap we should announce the previous and new branch names and the percent moved. propose aria-live snippet: ```
Traffic moved from branch/main to branch/exp-42: 60%
``` also the confirmation modal must have aria-describedby linking to the consequences list (what changes: model, config, traffic). ty: UX: timeline currently uses fuzzy hover zones — for keyboard users we need clear focusable timeline stops. add data-stop attributes per version and expose keyboard shortcuts to jump to next/prev stop ( ] and [ ). also consider small labels on stops when zoomed. kai: good. on copy: i'd like the modal confirm to read 'Switch to branch/exp-42 — moves 60% traffic. Reversible for 10 minutes via Rewind.' gives users a timebound safety window. Keep the window configurable. morgan: copy nit: 'Rewind' vs 'Undo' vs 'Rollback' — product likes Rewind for short reversible windows. we should show both in UI: toast 'Switched to exp-42 — Undo (U) available for 10m' and a persistent 'Rollback' action in the right rail for permanent reverts. rachel: keyboard/focus: when the confirm modal opens, trap focus and set initial focus on Cancel. avoid default focus on destructive. add data-focus-source attribute so we can restore focus to original timeline stop on close. also large-screen assistive tech: expose aria-describedby for the rollback action explaining difference between Rewind and Rollback. ty: interactions: the timeline scrub currently snaps to nearest commit id causing jumpy VO announcements. smoother behavior: maintain last-focused stop index and only announce when stable for 200ms. add aria-live polite for the interim and aria-live assertive for final confirm. a11y-bot: automated scan: - Missing aria-describedby on swap-confirm modal (suggest id: swap-consequences). - Timeline stops missing data-stop attributes and focusable roles (6 occurrences). - Swap CTA tooltip has no accessible name when collapsed (suggest aria-label: \"Swap branch to {name}\"). - Toast for undo missing role=\"status\" and keyboard hint (U). kai: action items: - design: update CTA to 'Swap branch' / compact tooltip option, add explicit 'Rewind 10m' text in modal, persistent Rollback in right rail (kai + morgan) - eng: add data-stop attrs, keyboard shortcuts [ and ] for stop nav, debounce announce timer 200ms, aria-live roles for interim and final (ty + rachel) - writing: confirm compact tooltip and toast copy variants, include keyboard hint (U) (morgan) - infra: ensure token contrast for rollback/destructive actions in dark headers (kai -> infra) rachel: quick test plan I'll run: 1) VO: open timeline, navigate stops with brackets, ensure aria-valuetext reads \"branch/exp-42, 60 percent\" 2) Swap: open confirm modal, ensure focus on Cancel, close with ESC and focus restored to timeline stop 3) Toast: trigger undo, ensure role=\"status\" announces and pressing 'U' triggers undo. morgan: will draft the small copy variants: - Modal header: \"Confirm switch to branch/exp-42\" - Modal body: \"This moves 60% traffic to branch/exp-42. Rewind available for 10 minutes.\" - Toast: \"Switched to exp-42 — press U to undo (10m)\" kai: can we get updated frames by Tue EOD? tagging @ty for component handoff. :white_check_mark: ty: yep. i'll add notes to the component PR about data-stop, keyboard shortcuts, and announce debounce. will also add tests for focus restoration. kai: thanks all — i'll update figma and ping when done. :sparkles:
